node.title: DLI official terminal weight-3 relations excluded by exhaustive affine-Galois norm census
node.statement: All C(256,3)2^2=11,054,080 reduced signed weight-3 polynomials at order 512 form exactly 254 affine-Galois norm classes. Exact resultants and complete certified factorizations have 439 distinct prime factors; none below 2^256 has v_2(q-1)>=41, and the maximum is 18. Hence no official DLI production row contains a terminal weight-3 relation. The verifier independently proves orbit coverage, reconstructs every resultant modulo a CRT modulus exceeding 2*3^256, and checks a shared 1,498-node recursive Pocklington tree. Weights 4 through 6 and WCL-ZONE remain open.
